verdict: Ideal exact-proximal MSBPG can be matched to this GW problem with an explicit entropy extension outside the feasible set, preserving every feasible KL update.

mapping.kernel: entropy t(log(t)-1) for0<=t<=1; -1+(t-1)^2/2 for t>=1; +infinity for t<0

assumptions.objective_and_lower_bound: pass: polynomial, nonnegative on compact U
assumptions.regularizer_and_domain_intersection: pass: closed convex transport indicator and positive product coupling
assumptions.global_kernel: pass using explicit extension; raw entropy alone is not globally uniformly strongly convex on whole positive orthant
assumptions.gradient_difference: pass globally with kappa=2L^2 and mu=1
assumptions.noise: pass: fresh independent q128 probes give conditional unbiasedness and uniformly finite variance/q on compact U
assumptions.initializations: pass for current square uniform-marginal product and randomized starts
assumptions.exact_prox: ideal minimizer stays positive; existing finite-tolerance numerical solver is not covered directly

conservative_schedule.L: any positive Hessian operator-norm upper bound;2nm*Cmax sufficient ifCmax>0
conservative_schedule.note: Sufficient conservative construction, not a recommended optimized tuning range.

output: Independent alpha-weighted random index J; expected squared Frobenius norm of (P_J-P_(J+1))/alpha_J. Not identical to Fatkhullin-He BFBE, endpoint loss, or an ordinary boundary KKT guarantee.
historical_custom_comparator: Constant proximal step with decreasing EMA coefficient did not match required coupling; cannot retrospectively relabel.
